task: Under a uniform information budget (G^1 + a*), which optimizer-response model best explains the update divergence?
revision_note: Revised from the original #61: removed the oracle predictor (h_replay = h_actual, R^2=1 by identity). All predictors now use only G^1 + a*_j (same information budget); the real G^g is used only to compute the target h and the scalar a*.

protocol.ground_truth: h_{t,i} = U^g_{t,i}/U_{t,i}, U^g = replay(G^g), U = replay(G^1) through the real RAdam recursion. The real G^g is used ONLY to compute the target h and the scalar a*; no predictor sees the full G^g.
protocol.information_budget: G^1 (reference gradient history) + a*_j = <G^g_j, G^1_j>/||G^1_j||^2 (per-step scalar projection of the gap)

predictors.global_scalar: causal mean a_bar_t = mean(a*_j, j<=t); Ghat = a_bar_t * G^1; replay RAdam -> h = replay(Ghat)/u1 (NO future leakage)
predictors.local_continuous: delta_j = a*_j - 1; A^(1) = (sum beta1^{t-j} delta_j G^1_j)/(sum beta1^{t-j} G^1_j); A^(2) = (sum beta2^{t-j} delta_j (G^1_j)^2)/(sum beta2^{t-j} (G^1_j)^2); h = 1 + A^(1) - A^(2)
predictors.discrete_replay: Ghat_j = a*_j * G^1_j (per-step scalar-scaled history); replay RAdam -> h = replay(Ghat)/u1

regimes.real: m0/v0/step0 from the frozen checkpoint (accumulated optimizer history)

protocol.effective_support: top 1% of coords by |u1| (np.partition quantile mask)

validation.replay: pure-numpy float32 RAdam (analysis/numpy_radam.py), validated against stored torch histories to ~1 ulp (cross-K verify_u1_final)
validation.firstorder_formula: verified correct for exact-scalar gaps from fresh start (Corr~0.9998); fails in truncated-real-history regime by design (incomplete history)
validation.synthetic_smoke: local synthetic near-scalar test passed (discrete > local > global in expected order) before server run
